title: A Caterpillar Lives in Spider Webs and Wears Its Victims' Body Parts

scenes.text: This caterpillar wears the body parts of dead insects.
It lives where no caterpillar should: in spider webs, on one Hawaiian island. It creeps up to insects the spider has trapped, and eats them.
What it can't eat, it keeps. Ant heads, fly wings and other leftovers go onto the silk case it carries around.
It's a disguise, worn inside the home of a predator.
In more than twenty years of searching, scientists found just 62 of them, all in one patch of mountain forest on Oahu. They even eat each other.
Its lineage is over five million years old. That's older than the island it lives on.

description:
The 'bone collector' is a carnivorous caterpillar found only on the Hawaiian island of Oahu. It lives in spider webs, feeds on insects caught there, and decorates its silk case with their inedible body parts, such as ant heads and fly wings.
Only 62 individuals were found in over two decades of fieldwork, in a patch of mountain forest of about 15 square kilometres, and they are cannibals. The lineage is more than five million years old, older than Oahu itself. The discovery was published in Science in April 2025.
What would you have named it?
subject: caterpillar in spider web
first_comment: Meat-eating caterpillars are well under 1 percent of all moth and butterfly species. What would you have named this one?
